verdict.rationale: The Solid README says the ecosystem includes component libraries, and one community member reports porting react-bootstrap to Solid, so third-party UI component libraries do exist. Whether the ecosystem is 'rich' is unproven: no specific libraries are named or documented, and community comments describe real ecosystem gaps and lagging ports. missing for 10: named, documented third-party UI component libraries, evidence of breadth or maturity of choice, independent corroboration that the ecosystem is rich rather than merely growing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework

citations.quote: the Solid ecosystem is growing fast, with custom primitives, component libraries, and build-time utilities
Ported react-bootstrap to SolidJS and found it fairly painless.
